featured_reviews.name: Kamala Chhadva
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kamla Chhadva (Silver Member, Homemaker)

My name is Kamla Chhadva (Age 50, Andheri, Mumbai). I have been associated with Paramsukh Total Wellness Life Counseling Global Gurukul for the past 15 years as a Silver Member.

Before joining, my life felt routine and directionless. As a homemaker, I was doing daily responsibilities but lacked a deeper purpose and inner clarity. After joining this Gurukul, the biggest change I experienced was inner peace. I found a sense of direction and a feeling that I am supported and guided.

One of the most important transformations has been in my mindset. Earlier, I used to overthink and get emotionally affected by small situations. Now I feel much calmer, more stable, and able to handle situations with clarity.

My family life has improved significantly. My relationship with my husband has become more understanding and balanced. With my children, the bond has become stronger and more positive. The overall environment at home feels more peaceful and harmonious.

Financially also, I have experienced stability and growth over time. I feel that things have aligned naturally without stress.

Health-wise, I have seen improvement as well. Earlier, I had frequent health concerns, but through the practices taught here, I feel more balanced and have reduced dependence on medicines.

Seva has played an important role in my journey. It has helped me build confidence, take decisions independently, and handle responsibilities with ease.

Spiritually, this path has given me deep peace and clarity. I have learned to stay calm, think positively, and trust the process of life.

Overall, this journey has brought positive transformation in every area of my life — mental, emotional, family, and spiritual.

I would definitely recommend this to others.

featured_reviews.name: Nitin Buricha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Nitin Shantilal Buricha (Age 61, Mulund, Mumbai), associated with Paramsukh Total Wellness Online Global Gurukul for nearly 20 years.

Joining this Gurukul has been a truly life-transforming journey. Through Gurudev’s guidance and Law of Nature–based teachings, I experienced growth in every area of life—mental peace, emotional balance, family harmony, financial clarity, and physical health.

I now handle stress better, make clearer decisions, and feel more stable and confident. My relationships have improved significantly, and my home environment has become peaceful and positive.

Practices like Prana Maitri and Sharir Maitri helped me stay healthy with minimal dependence on medicines. Spiritually, I gained a deeper understanding of life beyond rituals.

This is not just a program—it is a lifelong journey of transformation.

✅ Highly recommended for anyone seeking peace, clarity, and balanced life growth.

featured_reviews.name: vimala gala
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most powerful experiences in my life was during a serious illness. During that time, the entire Gurukul family stood by me. Gurudev’s guidance and the constant support of the family helped me recover. Even in the hospital and for years after, I received emotional, physical, and financial support. I truly feel that if I am healthy and alive today, it is because of Gurudev, Prabhu Krupa, and this family.

My name is Vimla Laxmichand Gala (Age 52, Dombivali, Mumbai). I am a Beautician and have been associated with Paramsukh Total Wellness Life Counseling Global Gurukul as a Gold Member for the past 16 years.

I joined this Gurukul because the moment I came here, I experienced a deep sense of peace and inner happiness. In a world full of stress and tension, this place gave me a feeling of calmness, positivity, and joy.

The Gold Membership has taught me how to live life practically—how to handle relationships, how to grow in work, and how to maintain the right behavior in every situation. It is not just learning, but a way of living.

In my personal life, there has been a beautiful transformation. My relationship with my husband has improved with acceptance and understanding. Earlier, I would react or feel upset, but now I have learned to accept situations calmly. My bond with my children has become stronger and more loving, and overall family harmony has improved significantly.

Financially as well, whenever I faced challenges, I received the right guidance and support. Over time, I have seen a steady growth in my financial condition.

Mentally and emotionally, the change has been remarkable. Earlier, I used to feel negative and go into depression, but now I feel happy, positive, and strong from within. I am able to take my own decisions confidently, and my stress-handling ability has improved a lot. Whenever I feel stressed, I follow the mantra given by Gurudev, and it brings immediate calmness.

Through practices like Pran Maitri and Sharir Maitri, I have also experienced improvement in my physical well-being.

The monthly programs and celebrations fill me with joy and positive energy. Whenever I come here, I instantly feel happy because the environment itself is so uplifting.

Being a part of seva, even in small ways, gives me a deep sense of happiness and responsibility. It has helped me grow in confidence and take responsibility in my own life as well.

Spiritually, I have experienced continuous growth. The processes taught here have helped me become more aware, peaceful, and connected. After the Sthapna of Bhagwan and Siddhachakra Yantra at home, the environment has become so positive that even visitors feel peace and relief when they spend time there.

Overall, this Gurukul is not just a place—it is a lifelong transformation family, always ready to support in every situation.

I wholeheartedly recommend this to everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Chetana Haria
featured_reviews.review_text:

The good news is your first session doesn't have to be complicated.

It's a conversation.

Some people arrive knowing what they want to talk about. Others aren't sure where to begin. Both are fine.

You don't need perfect words or a crisis. You don't need to explain your entire life story in one session.

🧠 5 Signs Anxiety May Be Affecting More Than Just Your Thoughts

When people think about anxiety, they usually think about worrying.
But anxiety doesn't always look like racing thoughts or panic attacks. Quite often, it shows up in subtle ways that affect your body, mood, energy levels, and daily life.
Here are five signs that anxiety may be playing a bigger role than you realise:

✔️ You're constantly tired, even after sleeping

✔️ You're struggling to concentrate

✔️ You feel more irritable than usual

✔️ You notice physical symptoms without a clear cause

✔️ You've started avoiding things

If several of these signs feel familiar, it may be worth paying attention.

Many people live with anxiety symptoms for months, sometimes years, before seeking support. They tell themselves they're just tired, stressed, busy, or overwhelmed. While those experiences are real, they can also be signs that your mind and body are asking for help.
Therapy can help you understand what's driving these patterns and develop healthier ways of coping with stress, worry, and anxiety.

🌿 You don't have to navigate it alone.

🌙 Why Do Your Thoughts Race at Night?

You're exhausted. Your body is ready to sleep.
But the moment your head hits the pillow, your mind starts replaying everything. 

💭 That conversation from earlier today
📧 The email you forgot to send
🗓️ Tomorrow's responsibilities
😟 The "what ifs" you can't seem to switch off

If this sounds familiar, you're not alone.
Many people experience nighttime anxiety, overthinking, and difficulty sleeping, even when they're physically tired. During the day, work, responsibilities, and distractions keep the mind occupied. At night, when everything becomes quiet, unresolved worries often come to the surface.

Common concerns I hear in therapy:
✔ "I can't stop thinking before bed."
✔ "I worry about things I can't control."
✔ "I'm exhausted but unable to sleep."
✔ "My heart races at night for no obvious reason."

These experiences are often linked to anxiety, stress, emotional overload, or an overactive nervous system. The good news is that these patterns can be understood and changed.

As a Clinical Psychologist in Mumbai, I help individuals identify the underlying causes of anxiety, overthinking, stress, and sleep-related difficulties, so they can experience lasting relief rather than temporary fixes.
